title: EIN, state tax ID and registration

sources.claim: An EIN can be obtained directly from the IRS for free ("you never have to pay a fee for an EIN"); if the business will be an LLC or corporation, form it with the state first or the EIN application may be delayed.
The SBA lists the launch steps (choose a structure, register, get federal and state tax IDs, apply for licenses and permits, open a business bank account, get insurance) as a general guide.

sections.skill: Tell the EIN apart from state tax IDs, registration and licenses

questions.prompt: Which ID is the federal tax ID?
questions.intro: Different numbers and filings do different jobs. The EIN is the FEDERAL tax ID from the IRS. A STATE tax ID or account may be needed for state taxes, such as collecting sales tax or paying state payroll taxes; it comes from the state's tax agency. BUSINESS REGISTRATION (forming an LLC, or filing a DBA) records the business or its name with the state or local government. A LICENSE gives permission to operate. Having one does not replace the others. The SBA lists getting federal and state tax IDs as separate launch steps.
questions.feedback: The EIN comes from the IRS.
